source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.5.2 with Figures 12.4 and 12.5 and Quick Check 12.2, printed pages 277-278.

blocks.text: NOₓ reactions ke ek silsile mein hissa leta hai jis se ozone (O₃), aldehydes, peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs) aur peroxybenzoyl nitrate (PBN) bante hain. PAN peroxyacyl nitrates ke khandan ka ek member hai; is ki aam banawat Figure 12.4 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Banawat: R ek C se jura hai jis ke oopar double bond wala O hai; C ek O se, woh O doosre O se, aur woh N se jura hai. N par + charge hai, daen taraf double bond wala O aur neeche single bond wala O jis par manfi charge hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.4: PANs ki aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 12.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is banawat ke teen hisse hain: R-C(=O)- acyl group, beech mein -O-O- peroxy jor, aur aakhir mein -NO2 (nitro) group. Is liye aam formula RC(O)OONO2 hai. Jab R = CH3 ho to yeh peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN) hai.
Peroxyacetyl nitrate mein R group CH₃ hai, lekin is ki jagah doosri hydrocarbon zanjeerein (chains) bhi ho sakti hain.

PAN kaise banta hai, yeh Figure 12.5 mein dikhaya gaya hai. Oxidising smog ka sab se bara hissa ozone hai, jo hydrocarbon ko oxidise kar ke aldehyde banati hai. Phir aldehyde hydroxyl radical (HO•) se react kar ke acyl radical banata hai. Acyl radical oxygen se react kar ke peroxyacyl radical banata hai, jo aakhir mein nitrogen peroxide (NO₂) se react kar ke peroxyacyl nitrate (PAN) banata hai.

blocks.caption: PAN banne ka mechanism (Figure 12.5)
rows: O₃ hydrocarbon (RCH₃) ko aldehyde (RCHO) mein oxidise karti hai

blocks.alt: Ek bayzavi (ellipse) cycle jis par teer ghari ki sooiyon ke rukh (clockwise) chalte hain. Reactive Hydrocarbon (sabz dabba) O3 se RCH2• deta hai jo cycle ke oopar hai; O2 se RCH2O2•; NO se RCH2O• + NO2; O2 se neeche HO2 + RCHO; HO2 aur NO se baen taraf NO2 + HO•; HO• aur RCH3 se dobara RCH2•. RCHO se neeche seedhi zanjeer: OH• se RC•=O, O2 se RC(=O)OO•, NO2 se RC(=O)OONO2.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.5: PAN banne ka mechanism (kitab ki Figure 12.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cycle mein har chakkar NO ko NO2 mein badalta hai aur HO• radical wapas aa jata hai, is liye cycle chalta rehta hai. Aldehyde RCHO cycle se nikal kar neeche wali zanjeer mein jata hai: OH• us se acyl radical RC•=O banata hai, O₂ se peroxyacyl radical RC(O)OO• banta hai, aur NO2 se PAN, RC(O)OONO2. Kitab ki shakal mein teen ghaltiyan hain jo hamare khaake mein theek ki gai hain: (1) RCH2• + O₂ ke baad 'RCH2O•' chhapa hai, sahi RCH2O2• hai; (2) aakhri dabbe mein 'OONO3' chhapa hai, sahi OONO2 hai (PAN = RC(O)OONO2); (3) cycle ke baen aadhe mein teer ulte rukh mein hain, jabke HO2 + NO se NO2 + HO• aur HO• + RCH3 se RCH2• banne ke liye poora cycle ek hi rukh mein chalta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) In oxides ki banawat banayein aur bonding mukhtasar batayein: i) N₂O ii) NO iii) NO₂.
blocks.explanation: i) N₂O linear hai: N≡N–O (ya N=N=O); nitrogen ki oxidation state +1. ii) NO mein 11 valence electrons (taaq tadaad) hain: N=O double bond aur nitrogen par ek akela (unpaired) electron, is liye paramagnetic; yeh kamzori se jur kar N₂O₂ (dimer) banata hai. iii) NO₂ mura hua (bent) hai, O–N=O, aur nitrogen par ek unpaired electron hai (paramagnetic); do NO₂ molecules N–N bond se jur kar N₂O₄ banate hain.

blocks.prompt: b) PAN ka matlab kya hai? Is ka aam formula dein.
blocks.explanation: PAN = peroxyacyl nitrate (jab R = CH₃ ho to peroxyacetyl nitrate). Aam formula RC(O)OONO₂.

blocks.prompt: c) PAN banane wale compounds ke formulas likhein.
blocks.explanation: Hydrocarbons (VOCs, masalan RCH₃), ozone O₃, hydroxyl radical HO•, oxygen O₂ aur nitrogen dioxide NO₂.

blocks.prompt: d) Jalta magnesium N₂O mein jalta rehta hai; is reaction ka product N₂O ki banawat ki tasdeeq kaise karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Reaction Mg + N₂O → MgO + N₂ hai. Oxygen nikal jane ke baad N₂ molecule bachta hai, yani N₂O mein dono nitrogen atoms aapas mein jure hain aur oxygen ek sire par hai: N–N–O, jaisa Table 12.2 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

items: PAN = peroxyacyl nitrate, RC(O)OONO₂; peroxyacetyl nitrate mein R = CH₃.
Hydrocarbon + O₃ → aldehyde; aldehyde + HO• → acyl radical; + O₂ → peroxyacyl radical; + NO₂ → PAN.
